FROM node:20-alpine

WORKDIR /app

ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1

COPY package.json ./
RUN npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund

COPY . .

ENV NODE_ENV=production
RUN npm run build

ENV PORT=3000
ENV HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0
EXPOSE 3000

CMD ["npm", "start"]

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2017",
    "lib": [
      "dom",
      "dom.iterable",
      "esnext"
    ],
    "allowJs": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "strict": true,
    "noEmit": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "module": "esnext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "jsx": "preserve",
    "incremental": true,
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "next"
      }
    ]
  },
  "include": [
    "next-env.d.ts",
    "**/*.ts",
    "**/*.tsx",
    ".next/types/**/*.ts"
  ],
  "exclude": [
    "node_modules"
  ]
}
